enjoyedMost: I really enjoyed the peer study sessions because we could learn from each other and ask questions without feeling shy. The tutors were always available and explained difficult topics in Maths and English in ways that finally made sense.
programImpact: This program helped me gain confidence in my studies and my WAEC results improved significantly, especially in core subjects. I feel better prepared for university now and I'm more sure about my academic abilities.
improvementSuggestions: The program could include more sessions on study skills and exam techniques, not just content, so students can manage their time better.

enjoyedMost: I really enjoyed the maths classes because the teachers explained things in a way that made sense to me. The group activities were fun too—I liked studying with my friends and we would help each other understand the difficult topics.
programImpact: The program helped me improve my grades, especially in English and maths, which has made me more confident in class. I feel more prepared now as I move to Senior School and I'm not as worried about my studies anymore.
improvementSuggestions: I think the program should add more computer classes because we need to learn technology skills for our future jobs.

enjoyedMost: I liked the reading activities most because we got to read interesting stories together. It was fun having the teachers help us when we didn't understand big words.
programImpact: The program helped me become better at reading and writing in English. Now I feel more confident when I raise my hand in my regular school class.
improvementSuggestions: I think it would be better if we had more time for math lessons because that's my weakest subject.

enjoyedMost: I really liked the maths lessons because the teacher explained things better than at school. The group activities were fun too, and I made some good friends there.
programImpact: The program helped me get better at reading and writing, especially in English. Even though I'm not in school or training now, I still remember some of the things I learned there.
improvementSuggestions: They should make the classes shorter or less strict so more students like me don't get tired and drop out.

enjoyedMost: I liked the free lessons and how the teachers made learning fun, especially during the practical classes. It was better than regular school because we got more attention.
programImpact: The program helped me understand some subjects better and gave me confidence to try new things. Even though I dropped out, I picked up some skills that I still use.
improvementSuggestions: The program should make the schedule more flexible because some of us have to help at home or work, and that's why many of us stop coming.

enjoyedMost: I enjoyed the extra lessons most because they helped me understand difficult Maths problems better than in regular class. My favorite part was when we played games with English vocabulary because it made learning fun and I could remember the words easily.
programImpact: The program helped me improve my grades especially in English and Maths, which made me confident when I finished JSS2. The teachers were patient and explained things in a way that made sense, so I felt ready for secondary school.
improvementSuggestions: The program could add more science practicals and experiments so we can learn by doing things with our hands instead of just sitting and listening.
